standard.title: Joined letters consistent in size
standard.description: write words using joined letters that are clearly formed and consistent in size
standard.prior_knowledge: Students have developed letter formation in earlier years. They have not yet focused on joining letters consistently in handwriting.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students write words using joined letters that are clearly formed and consistent in size.

nodes.label: Joined handwriting with consistent size
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can write words using joined letters that are clearly formed and consistent in size.
nodes.minimum_width: Write a set of words using joined letters, demonstrating clear letter formation and consistent size across a line of writing.
nodes.typical_width: Write words and sentences using joined letters that are clearly formed and consistent in size across extended writing tasks.
wider: Compare joined and unjoined writing of the same text and discuss how consistency of size and joining affects readability
Practise joins that students find most difficult and reflect on what makes those joins challenging

response_modes.reason: Handwriting is a motor skill — fluency and consistency develop through regular practice, not through conceptual extension. Repeated, distributed practice across varied writing tasks is the mechanism for improvement.

success_criteria: Student's joined letters are clearly formed (distinguishable from each other)
Student maintains consistent letter size within a word and across a line
